facts.fact: Yes: on 31 Jul 2026 the Union Cabinet approved continuing PM-KISAN from 2026-27 to 2030-31
facts.quote: Cabinet approves continuation of the PM-KISAN Scheme from 2026-27 to 2030-31 with a Financial Outlay of Rs.3.15 lakh crore Posted On: 31 JUL 2026 4:13PM by PIB Delhi

facts.fact: The approved financial outlay for 2026-27 to 2030-31 is Rs 3.15 lakh crore
facts.quote: A total financial outlay of Rs.3.15 lakh crore has been approved for the Scheme during this period.

summary: PIB 31 Jul 2026 confirms Cabinet continuation of PM-KISAN for 2026-27 to 2030-31 with Rs 3.15 lakh crore outlay.
